newsitem.title: FRANCE: Car bomb explodes in Algiers, three dead - agency.
newsitem.headline: Car bomb explodes in Algiers, three dead - agency.

text.p: PARIS, July 31, Reuter - A car bomb exploded in Algiers on Wednesday evening, killing three people and wounding 25 others, the Algerian security forces said in a statement carried by the official APS news agency .
The statement said the bomb went off at 7.40 p.m. (1840 GMT) on the Boulevard Bougara in the El Biar district of the Algerian capital.
More than 170 civilians have been killed by Moslem rebels in Bilda province and the neighbouring Tipaza region in the past week.
About 60,000 people have been killed since early 1992 when authorities cancelled a general election in which the radical Islamic Salvation Front (FIS) had taken a commanding lead.
